invariants: Reuse the existing application assembly, Docker Compose supervisor, provider boundary and canonical data stores; create no service or model executor.
The repository-local bootstrap must import only the standard library before installing canonical Python metadata.
A first install generates private stable Mongo, JWT and engine-service credentials; valid existing credentials are preserved unless the operator explicitly requests rotation.
Receipts, diagnostics and subprocess failures contain no credential values or rendered Compose environment.
Default local mode is unavailable until a genuine trained model is configured; healthy application services do not establish AI or crawler readiness.
Provider credentials and model construction remain engine-owned; diagnostics never invoke a model or crawl a URL.
Operator-approved emulator cores and toolchains remain optional and do not become ready merely because configuration variables exist.
Startup and live probes use the declared topology and actual configured public ports; parameter validation precedes startup mutation.
Missing dependencies, daemon access and configuration produce actionable bounded failures without installing privileged prerequisites automatically.
GameForge auth uses its existing independently generated persistent GAMEFORGE_JWT_SECRET; no public fallback key or default-password admin account is created.

Minimal first-install startup retains schema/index/auth bootstrap but skips bulk generated content, launch prefill and automatic Android toolchain installation. Heavy content is an explicit operator opt-in, not evidence of learned or crawled knowledge.
Consolidate source-copy layers and explicitly bound build concurrency; do not change the managed Docker storage driver or delete unrelated images, runtime containers or volumes to recover capacity.

Production Expo embeds only explicit public backend/engine build endpoints, and backend CORS receives an explicit origin allowlist; runtime-only environment variables cannot reconfigure an already exported browser bundle.

Setup creates the operator-owned local-model bind directory before Docker can auto-create it as root, without acquiring assets, modifying existing assets or activating a model. Existing empty directories that the operator cannot write produce an actionable failure.

The existing Curiosity owner uses the declared backend_data volume via CURIOSITY_DATA_ROOT=/app/data/curiosity rather than the read-only source tree. Minimal installation keeps its automatic idle research disabled unless explicitly enabled.
Compose forwards the existing DB_NAME setting to core.databases, keeping the configured CORE_DB Mongo namespace authoritative instead of silently ignoring operator database selection.

Both uppercase and lowercase NO_PROXY explicitly include Compose service and loopback hosts while retaining operator bypass entries, so inherited proxy settings cannot intercept private authenticated backend-to-engine traffic. External proxy configuration remains available to its existing owners.
The production Nginx loopback health probe explicitly disables wget proxy use; external proxy configuration cannot turn a healthy local listener into a false health failure.

diagnostic_report.semantics: Read-only configuration and observed canonical health projection. Unprobed capability states remain unknown; configuration is not execution evidence.

engine_image.abi: glibc Debian Trixie, matching operator-provisioned Linux llama.cpp CLI; no Windows-native or ARM-model-recipe readiness claim
engine_image.model_activation: explicit AI_LOCAL_DEPLOYMENT_PATH only after exact operator assets are prepared
engine_image.build_proxy_ca: optional BuildKit secret only; never installed into image layers
engine_image.dependency_source: pyproject.toml project.dependencies plus local-inference/hosted-inference and exact build-system requirements, resolved before source; editable canonical package registration uses --no-deps

operator_bootstrap.input: paired explicit email and private regular password file; no password argument, no public default or automatic first-user elevation
operator_bootstrap.password_bounds: at least 16 Unicode characters, at most 72 UTF-8 bytes, no embedded control characters; optional single trailing line ending
operator_bootstrap.serialization: literal quoted Compose-compatible .env, dollar interpolation escaped, never return credential values
operator_bootstrap.preflight: validate both inputs before creating or changing .env

studio_continuation.native_setup: Existing pinned operator installers only; no browser shell, automatic firmware/content download or readiness inferred from configuration.
studio_continuation.dragon_bootstrap: SKL_DRAGON_RUNTIME_BOOTSTRAP=1 initializes empty existing practice/knowledge schemas on backend_data; never approves raw crawled knowledge or starts automatic training.
